en.headline: Law says government must balance market and fans on ticket scalping rules
en.dek: Culture secretary tells LegCo that any tighter controls on consignment tickets or real-name systems will be studied carefully so as not to deter event organisers.
body: Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law told the Legislative Council on Wednesday that the government remains concerned about ticket scalping and fake tickets but will approach any new rules with caution.

In a written reply to a question from Revd Canon the Hon Peter Douglas Koon, Law said the causes of scalping involve market structure and supply and demand. She added that the government must weigh market reactions, operational costs and practical enforcement before changing the ratio of consignment tickets or introducing wider real-name requirements, so that organisers are not discouraged from staging events in Hong Kong.

Law noted that the Places of Public Entertainment Ordinance already makes it an offence to resell tickets above the organiser’s price at licensed venues, with a fine of $2,000. For Leisure and Cultural Services Department venues, staff patrol and stop unauthorised sales. Since 2019 the department has lowered the ceiling on consignment tickets to 70 per cent for events with four or more performances at the Hong Kong Coliseum and Queen Elizabeth Stadium, and it continues to encourage higher public-sale shares. At Kai Tak Sports Park, operators generally require at least 50 per cent of tickets to be offered to the public.

Police do not keep separate figures on scalping reports, and the Leisure and Cultural Services Department received none in the past three years. The government will keep studying practices elsewhere, including the mainland, Japan and Korea, and consulting the industry. Law again urged the public to buy only through official channels.

zh.headline: 羅淑佩指打擊黃牛須平衡市場運作與觀眾體驗
zh.dek: 文化體育及旅遊局局長書面回覆立法會，指任何收緊內部門票比例或實名制安排均須審慎考慮，以免令主辦單位卻步。
body: 文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩周三書面回覆立法會，表示政府一直關注門票炒賣及假票問題，但會以審慎態度研究任何新措施。
回覆選委界議員管浩鳴質詢時，羅淑佩指出，門票炒賣成因複雜，涉及市場結構及供求。政府須審視市場反應、營運成本及實際執行等因素，再決定是否進一步下調內銷門票比例上限，或擴大實名制，以免影響主辦單位來港辦活動的意欲。
她重申，《公眾娛樂場所條例》已禁止在須領牌場所高於票價轉售門票，違者可被罰款二千元。康文署場地則由職員巡查並制止場內轉售。自二〇一九年七月起，紅館及伊利沙伯體育館四場或以上節目的內銷門票上限已由八成降至七成，並持續鼓勵主辦單位提高公開發售比例。啟德體育園營運公司一般亦要求至少五成門票公開發售。
警方沒有備存網上或實體炒賣舉報數字，康文署過去三年亦無接獲相關舉報。政府會繼續參考內地及其他地方做法，並與業界保持溝通。羅淑佩再次呼籲市民透過官方渠道購票，以免受騙。
